pair_order_rule: alternate query_then_pass and pass_then_query by one-based pair ordinal within each scene
mutation_rule: ignore absolute one-action pose changes; fail only for query-only logical/identity change or positive Query-minus-matched-Pass pose excess above a frozen threshold; matched Pass logical/identity change is a background-integrity failure

support_policy_candidate_rule.selection_rule: predeclared semantic Book support type, present as a receptacle, with a positive reset-isolated qualification-aligned spawn query in at least one inspected scene and zero paired-causal query effects

execution_gate: run only from a clean committed revision; stop immediately on a paired-causal query effect or matched-control background-integrity failure
privacy: public evidence contains scene/type/ordinal counts, pair orders, booleans, digests, categorized errors, anonymous absolute diagnostics, and Query-minus-Pass excesses only; no objectId, coordinates, exact poses, target points, or registry content
